transcript: Why do I hear laughing in here? What is going on? We're sit practicing. Sit what? Watch, watch, watch. What is she doing to you, Ellie? No, she was doing so good a second ago. Ready? See, she's practicing. Ellie, mommy's trying to teach you how to sit. Ready? We're working on it. Ellie, sweetie, you're so good at sitting. Yay! That's funny. She's really good when she props up on the pillows. She gets so happy about it. Ready? Ellie! You're like a big girl. Hold on. I gotta go get something. I almost forgot. We have to take a picture. A picture? Ellie, that's the cutest thing I've ever seen. Are y'all friends? You and your friend are sitting. What?
metadata_caption: Ellie’s laugh at the end! 🥹😂 backstory ::: While at a checkup with Ellie’s doctor, we were told that she was excelling with her head support and hitting all of the milestones that she should be at for her age! He also said that if we wanted, we could start doing assisted sitting practices with her! ❤️ Kay was so excited at this news and, just recently, has been practicing with her from time to time after tummy times, not prioritizing it, but trying to give her the ability to practice some! 😂 I walked into one of these sessions and found Kay and Ellie practicing! It is so funny how Ellie will balance for a second and then accept her fate as she falls over without even trying to catch herself. 😂 It’s so funny for us to see, and Ellie seems to enjoy it too. We are so excited for her to be able to sit up on her own! It’s amazing how far she has come in only (almost) 5 months. I am so excited to see her continue to grow and learn new things! ❤️ #kayandtayofficial #couples #relationships #pregnant #postpartum
